newsitem.title: USA: Exide Electronics wins Air Force contract.
newsitem.headline: Exide Electronics wins Air Force contract.

text.p: Exide Electronics Group Inc said Monday it had won a contract from the Air Force with a potential value of $625 million to provide and service power supply systems.
The company said the contract, which comes into effect immediately, is worth $375 million for the first three years and $125 million for each of two optional years.
It said revenues from the contract would depend on actual requirements and purchases, if any, made by the Air Force and other agencies.
Under the contract, Exide will provide Uninterruptible Power Systems as well an ancillary equipment, spare parts, training, installation and maintenance services.
